entities.summary: Evgeny Korotkov is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He last played on a tryout for HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Korotkov returned to HC CSKA Moscow in a trade after three seasons with Amur Khabarovsk on May 20, 2014.
